name: Jether
bio: Jether was Gideon's firstborn son. After Gideon captured Zebah and Zalmunna, the Midianite kings who had killed his brothers, he told Jether to step forward and kill them, but Jether, still young, was too afraid and did not draw his sword (Judges 8:20). Seeing that his son could not bring himself to do it, Gideon rose and killed the kings himself. This small detail shows that not even within Gideon's own household did everyone have the nerve to carry out such a weighty act of killing.
